title: Field Scanning
subtitle: Lens turns unknown signals into usable decisions
summary: A useful scan answers what the object is, how dangerous it is, what to do next, and whether it should become a map marker.
body: Scan from relative safety before entering a route. Cache casings, route boards, relay nodes, faction signs, and hazard warnings all provide different kinds of field intel.
If a scan links to a mission, complete the smallest safe objective first. If it links to a future hazard, mark it and leave.
Scan results should unlock or point to the matching Index entry so the player always gets a clear risk label, next action, and route link.
